subject: literacy
concept: Writing a complete short argument paragraph: claim, reason, example, acknowledgment of another view, and conclusion
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student plans their paragraph using a simple claim/reason/example/conclusion graphic organizer
exercise.abstract: Student writes a full short argument paragraph combining all skills from this unit

assessment.mastery_threshold: paragraph contains a clear claim, at least one reason with a specific example, and a non-repetitive conclusion
misconception_flags: omits the specific example, leaving only a general reason

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
